landcover_denominator: Valid land-cover cells within each airport-centered zone. No valid coverage produces missing fractions, not zeros.
coverage: Valid 30 m pixel area divided by geometric area, capped at one; land-cover and impervious coverage must each reach 0.95 in every ring. Reference identity screening also applies.
imperviousness: Separate from the nine-part composition; valid values 0–100, divided by 100 for fitting.
ring_inputs: Water plus wetland and cropland in each of r00_03, r03_08 and r08_13; six variables.
timing: Calendar-year measurements from a retrospective collection; reference year does not establish historical product availability.
selection_scope: Fitted representations change variables and spatial support; selected radius is not an ecological boundary.
